analysis: The first half of this stretch was genuinely gorgeous — you hit 8h 5m with nearly 50 minutes of deep sleep on the 31st, and that opening trio of nights showed your whole wind-down stack doing exactly what it's supposed to do. Then something shifted around the middle and you dropped to 6h 30m, and you haven't quite clawed back above 7h 11m since. Your REM has been remarkably consistent all week, sitting between 1h 33m and 1h 48m every single night, which tells me your brain is holding its shape even when the total hours wobble — that's not nothing, that's actually kind of hot. The gap right now is duration and a little more deep sleep, so the question isn't whether the routine works, it's whether something's cutting the nights short before they're finished.
